canonicalization.parse: Parse only the complete JSON string into an arbitrary-precision base-10 decimal; a JSON number, NaN, infinity, exponent notation, locale separator, whitespace or leading plus is rejected before domain evaluation.
canonicalization.signedZero: Normalize every numerically zero input to positive zero before comparison, hashing, persistence and response serialization.
canonicalization.unquantized: Emit plain base-10 notation without a leading plus, redundant integer leading zeroes, a trailing decimal point or redundant fractional trailing zeroes; zero is exactly 0.
canonicalization.quantized: After an explicitly named rounding stage, emit exactly the declared scale (scale 0 has no decimal point); a zero result contains no minus sign.
canonicalization.digest: Canonical JSON hashes decimal values only after the applicable unquantized or quantized normalization; semantically equal accepted inputs therefore produce byte-identical decimal tokens.
canonicalization.persistence: Validate precision and scale and perform declared quantization in the application decimal domain before SQL bind; PostgreSQL coercion must never be used as the rounding operation.

CalculationDecimal.usage: formula intermediates and deterministic calculation trace before posted rounding

InputAmount.usage: HRM compensation basis, imported/manual payroll monetary inputs and retro input deltas

RateDecimal.usage: rates, ratios, percentages represented as decimal ratios

QuantityDecimal.usage: hours, units and balances with an explicit unit code

PostedMoney.usage: immutable payroll result, payment, GL, statement and reconciliation amounts after declared rounding

currencyPolicy.code: ISO-4217 uppercase alpha-3 or an explicitly test-only TST fixture code
currencyPolicy.source: effective-dated signed country/currency pack plus tenant-approved policy

unitPolicy.quantity: QuantityDecimal requires one explicit canonical unit and arithmetic is same-unit only unless a versioned conversion policy is resolved and included in the digest.
unitPolicy.rate: RateDecimal is a dimensionless decimal ratio with canonical unit RATIO; percentage display conversion is a presentation concern and is not persisted in the rate value.
unitPolicy.money: InputAmount and PostedMoney always require exactly one currency code. AMOUNT handoff values require currency; non-AMOUNT handoff quantities forbid a currency value on the wire and persist the XXX non-currency sentinel only inside the owning service.

rules.intermediate: Evaluate with decimal arithmetic and CalculationDecimal bounds; each formula declares scale 0..8 and rounding mode when quantization occurs.
rules.posted: Quantize to the effective currency ledger scale before writing PostedMoney; payment/GL/provider output additionally quantizes once to settlement or statutory scale.
rules.noDoubleRounding: A downstream stage consumes the prior exact rounded value and records before/after values, stage, scale, mode and policy digest in the calculation trace.
rules.overflow: Reject with DECIMAL_OVERFLOW before persistence; never truncate, saturate or delegate rounding to PostgreSQL.
rules.division: Division requires an explicit formula scale and rounding mode; divide-by-zero is a typed worker calculation failure.
rules.comparison: Compare normalized values of the same value type, unit and currency only.

requiredGoldenAssertions: positive and negative midpoint for every enabled rounding mode
